answer: The Vertex desk posts a fresh word on the Mesa board daily, and every claim must carry it in its sample, filed that day. A cedar warden checks each sample; one without the word, or filed late, is void and forfeits a 300-coin bond. One worker risks one bond; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 fresh samples a day and lose 300,000 coins. One farm filed forty claims with last week's samples; none carried Tuesday's word, and all forty bonds were gone Friday.
